datasets.name: dc899d94
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT max(run_id) AS run_id
    FROM waterkeringbeheer_prd.jvanruitenbeek.pastas_fit_metrics
)
SELECT
    f.*,
    r.meetlocatie_code,
    m.naam                      AS location_name,
    m.compartiment_naam,
    m.peilgebiedpraktijk_code,
    m.meetreeks_actief,
    m.wgs84_xcoordinaat,
    m.wgs84_ycoordinaat,
    m.rd_xcoordinaat,
    m.rd_ycoordinaat,
    r.begin_filter,
    r.eind_filter
FROM waterkeringbeheer_prd.jvanruitenbeek.pastas_fit_metrics f
JOIN latest l
  ON l.run_id = f.run_id
LEFT JOIN gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.meetreeks r
       ON r.id = f.meetreeks_id
LEFT JOIN gold_prd.hl_cs_objecten.meetlocatie m
       ON m.id   = r.meetlocatie_object_id
       OR m.code = trim(r.meetlocatie_code)
WHERE f.model_type = 'tarso'
ORDER BY f.evp DESC;

datasets.name: b2fc3dd2
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT max(run_id) AS run_id
    FROM waterkeringbeheer_prd.jvanruitenbeek.pastas_fit_metrics
),
checks AS (
    SELECT
        c.run_id,
        c.meetreeks_id,
        c.model_type,

        -- response memory
        max(CASE WHEN c.`check` LIKE 'response_memory%' THEN c.statistic END)      AS response_memory_stat,
        max(CASE WHEN c.`check` LIKE 'response_memory%' THEN c.operator END)       AS response_memory_operator,
        max(CASE WHEN c.`check` LIKE 'response_memory%' THEN c.threshold END)      AS response_memory_threshold,
        bool_and(CASE WHEN c.`check` LIKE 'response_memory%' THEN c.passed END)    AS response_memory_pass,

        -- parameter bounds (may be one row per parameter; failing if ANY is on a bound)
        count(CASE WHEN c.`check` LIKE 'parameter_bounds%' THEN 1 END)             AS parameter_bounds_n,
        count(CASE WHEN c.`check` LIKE 'parameter_bounds%' AND NOT c.passed THEN 1 END)
                                                                                   AS parameter_bounds_n_failed,
        bool_and(CASE WHEN c.`check` LIKE 'parameter_bounds%' THEN c.passed END)   AS parameter_bounds_pass,
        min(CASE WHEN c.`check` LIKE 'parameter_bounds%' THEN c.threshold_min END) AS parameter_bounds_threshold_min,
        max(CASE WHEN c.`check` LIKE 'parameter_bounds%' THEN c.threshold_max END) AS parameter_bounds_threshold_max,
        concat_ws(' | ', collect_list(
            CASE WHEN c.`check` LIKE 'parameter_bounds%' AND NOT c.passed
                 THEN coalesce(c.comment, c.`check`) END
        ))                                                                         AS parameter_bounds_failed_detail
    FROM waterkeringbeheer_prd.jvanruitenbeek.pastas_model_checks c
    JOIN latest l ON l.run_id = c.run_id
    GROUP BY c.run_id, c.meetreeks_id, c.model_type
)
SELECT
    f.*,
    ck.response_memory_stat,
    ck.response_memory_operator,
    ck.response_memory_threshold,
    ck.response_memory_pass,
    ck.parameter_bounds_n,
    ck.parameter_bounds_n_failed,
    ck.parameter_bounds_pass,
    ck.parameter_bounds_threshold_min,
    ck.parameter_bounds_threshold_max,
    ck.parameter_bounds_failed_detail,
    r.meetlocatie_code,
    m.naam                      AS location_name,
    m.compartiment_naam,
    m.peilgebiedpraktijk_code,
    m.meetreeks_actief,
    m.wgs84_xcoordinaat,
    m.wgs84_ycoordinaat,
    m.rd_xcoordinaat,
    m.rd_ycoordinaat,
    r.begin_filter,
    r.eind_filter
FROM waterkeringbeheer_prd.jvanruitenbeek.pastas_fit_metrics f
JOIN latest l
  ON l.run_id = f.run_id
LEFT JOIN checks ck
       ON ck.run_id       = f.run_id
      AND ck.meetreeks_id = f.meetreeks_id
      AND ck.model_type   = f.model_type
LEFT JOIN gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.meetreeks r
       ON r.id = f.meetreeks_id
LEFT JOIN gold_prd.hl_cs_objecten.meetlocatie m
       ON m.id   = r.meetlocatie_object_id
       OR m.code = trim(r.meetlocatie_code)
WHERE f.model_type = 'tarso'
ORDER BY f.evp DESC;
